entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A veteran commander of the Gavony Riders who relied on the moon's phases in battle, lost kin to werewolves, and captures a cursed creature that claims to be Garruk.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: Odric's lieutenant and second in command, who led an assault on ghouls near Hanweir and keeps her hope and compassion.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker, weakened and cursed with black veins and a werewolf-like appearance, captured in a net by Odric's trap.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel who returned and cleansed Innistrad, ending the moon's control over life and death.

entities.name: Mayor of Torbach
entities.description: A pompous, grieving administrator whose son died after fleeing a werewolf.

entities.name: Widow of Bitterheart Hill
entities.description: An outcast woman whose cottage was destroyed and who was found dead without wounds.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A mad alchemist still being hunted by the Church.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer being transported to Thraben, who caused great trouble with Geralf.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: Gisa's partner in the tyranny of the moorlands.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel whose forces hunt the perpetrators of the Nephalia Massacre.

entities.name: Avacynian Church
entities.description: The church that Odric serves and whose power he tracks through regimental dispatches.

entities.name: Gavony Riders
entities.description: The regiment that Odric commands.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: The soldiers of the Church who serve in Odric's regiment.

entities.name: Healers of Heron
entities.description: A group named in the town crier's news.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: The event by which Avacyn rid the land of the lycanthrope curse.

entities.name: Nephalia Massacre
entities.description: A massacre whose perpetrators Sigarda's forces hunt.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison whose escapees Avacyn focuses on hunting.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city housing the cathedral where Odric works and the place the prisoner will be brought.

entities.name: Torbach
entities.description: A village where the mayor's son died fleeing a werewolf.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: The moorlands where Grete's friends hunt the last of the ghouls.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The province to which the vampires have retreated.

entities.name: Witchbane's orb
entities.description: A magical ward against curses created by the widow, used as a lure in Odric's trap.

events.summary: Odric reflects in Thraben that Avacyn's return has ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
events.quote: The phases of the moon were no longer predictors of life and death now that Avacyn had returned and cleansed the world.

events.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
Grete reports that the mayor's son in Torbach died after fleeing a werewolf; Odric, doubting in his heart, orders the regiment roused.
The grieving mayor of Torbach rants at Odric and Grete, blaming the Church for a werewolf that slaughtered the widow of Bitterheart Hill.
events.quote: "It slaughtered the widow of Bitterheart Hill!" the mayor interrupted.

events.summary: Odric promises the mayor to find and kill the monster that killed his son.
events.quote: "We will find the monster that killed your son and put its head on a pike,"

events.summary: Odric decides that something about the widow attracted the monster and plans a trap near her cottage.
events.quote: Something about her attracted the monster. We'll set a trap near there.

events.summary: At midnight Odric and Grete lie in wait by a witchbane's orb baited with the widow's blood, and Odric recalls that her corpse showed no sign of werewolf violence.
events.quote: There was no evidence she'd been killed by a werewolf attack

events.summary: A tall shadow enters the clearing, and cathars drop a heavy net on the creature.
events.quote: Odric shouted to the cathars in the treetops, who cast down the heavy net

events.summary: Grete stops Odric from striking and he sees a human arm, human eyes and a face crisscrossed with black veins.
events.quote: Then he saw the arm—a human arm—a hand, and human eyes

events.summary: The creature identifies itself as Garruk Wildspeaker, weakened and cursed.
events.quote: "I'm weakened, cursed, and no threat to you," it said.

events.summary: Enraged, Odric smashes the pommel of his sword against Garruk's temple, dropping him.
events.quote: Odric bashed the blunt end of his sword against the monster's temple

events.summary: Grete pleads that the creature is not a werewolf and proposes bringing it alive to Thraben.
events.quote: "Let us bring it to Thraben—alive. Leave the days of slaughter behind us.

events.summary: Odric lets go of Garruk, sheathes his sword and orders him drugged and tied for the road to Thraben.

relations.note: She is his lieutenant and second in command.
relations.quote: He glanced across the oak table at Grete, his lieutenant

relations.note: He tracks the Church's power and leads its cathars.
relations.quote: much better suited to combat maneuvers than negotiating the politics of the Avacynian Church.

relations.note: Her forces hunt perpetrators in line with Avacyn's rule.
relations.quote: Sigarda's forces were hunting the perpetrators of the Nephalia Massacre.

relations.note: She rid the land of the lycanthrope curse.
relations.quote: Every morning since the Cursemute had rid the land of the lycanthrope curse

relations.note: Odric captures him and nearly kills him believing him a werewolf.
